answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 150007 Country: Bangladesh Title: Computer business. Question: I am too much interested about computer parts business. Some Maulana said this business is halal but I am confuse about this halal. How? Most of the time people use it badly. People watch movies and other bad thing which is gunah in Islam. So if I am doing this business it would be gunah-e-jaria. So I trust Deoband. So I want to know is this business halal or haram? Answer ID: 150007 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1019/1015/L=8/1438) The parts of the computers are costly and valuable per se. There is no harm in selling and purchasing. If someone misuses the computer then he shall be responsible for the same, you are not responsible for the same. However, if you are sure about someone that he shall misuse the computer necessarily then you should avoid selling him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
